Name: Cheaper and more Accessible Catalogues
Author: weissnicht01
Description:
Do you want to decorate you house? Does the traveling merchant not give you the catalogue you desire? Then this mod is right for you!

_____________

Changes the cost of all buyable furniture catalogues.
The traveling merchant will sell the retro, junimo and joja catalogue (if Joja no longer exists) every day instead of offering them on random days.
The trash catalogue is also available at the traveling merchant.
The individual prices and extra availability are customisable in the config.
If you want to change them in-game, use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu [/url]

_____________

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Requires game version 1.6
